items.name: Gauth Unlimited Digital Canvas
items.tagline: An AI tutor on an infinite whiteboard, not a chat thread
items.description: Gauth AI Course now runs on an Unlimited Digital Canvas: one continuous whiteboard where lessons unfold spatially instead of in a chat thread or slide deck. Chapters expand side by side as narration plays, board notes write out in sync with the AI voice, and you can zoom from the full concept map down to a single formula. Pause anytime to ask the AI Tutor, and it answers right on the board beneath your step. Generate a canvas lesson on any topic, then export it as a PDF or share a link.

items.name: Veltrix AI for E-commerce
items.tagline: Find how your e-commerce business could earn more
items.description: Find ways to make your e-commerce business more profitable. Veltrix uses AI to analyze your sales, costs, customers and marketing. Get help deciding what to promote, where to cut spending and how to solve problems holding the business back. Connect your business tools or upload files. Start with a Business Health Check to find improvements you may have missed. Then use Veltrix to work out what to improve. Your first check is free. No card required.

items.name: Teachoo
items.tagline: AI that helps you learn anything and everything.
items.description: Teachoo helps students work through homework one question at a time. Type a problem or upload a photo, then work toward the answer with guided questions, feedback and hints. Need more help? Ask for a bigger hint or an explanation of the step. Free to use. Try a problem you haven’t solved in years.

items.name: Famulor
items.tagline: Your agent to answer calls and follow ups on WhatsApp
items.description: Famulor answers calls, runs campaigns and follows up on WhatsApp. GDPR-ready, EU hosting. Try it free.

items.name: ShipHQ
items.tagline: Build your own app studio, powered by your real apps
items.description: ShipHQ turns your app's real numbers into a living isometric startup office. Connect RevenueCat and every paying subscriber becomes a person at your desks. Each morning the Daily Brief replays last night: new subscribers walk in to applause, trials arrive in caps, churn gets a send-off. Milestones land as trophies on your wall — earned, never bought, never retroactive. AI managers bring a 09:00 standup on growth, reviews and competitors. Free on iPhone.

items.name: Mintlify Desktop
items.tagline: An AI-native app for writing documentation and knowledge
items.description: A dedicated home for all your documentation, from internal knowledge bases, runbooks and onboarding guides to public docs. Keep projects open side by side across organizations and pick up where you left off. An agent works alongside you on the page you’re editing, while local files let you write offline and sync when you reconnect. Tabs, split views, and persistent sessions help you move between projects without losing context.

items.name: Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo
items.tagline: Elevenlabs' fastest and most emotive voice models yet
items.description: Meet Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo by ElevenLabs, their most expressive models yet, with Turbo built for real-time use. Available in apps, API, and agents.

items.name: Bambu Lab R1
items.tagline: CO2 laser cutting with Bambu-style automation
items.description: Bambu Lab R1 is a 55W CO2 laser cutter built around automation. It handles optical alignment, material positioning and surface tracking for you, with a 600 × 300 mm work area, clear acrylic support, and optional conveyor processing up to 3 meters.

items.name: Clef
items.tagline: Open-source decision models from Cloudflare
items.description: Clef is a 27B multimodal model that turns a state and a schema of typed questions into decisions. It reads the state as text, JSON, images, or video, and returns a probability for every allowed option of every question in a single forward pass. There is no free-form text generation and no output parsing. The Clef API is fully compatible with Jev and SystemOne.

items.name: Open Inspector
items.tagline: Hover any website, get its design system. Open-source. Free.
items.description: A free, open-source browser extension for inspecting layout, styles, colour, type and assets on any page, and exporting its design tokens. Unlike the popular alternatives, it requests no site access and makes zero network requests. MIT, no account.

items.name: Syllaby AI Avatar 2.0
items.tagline: Create Your Own Avatar In Seconds
items.description: Turn a script or simple idea into a complete presenter-led video with a realistic AI avatar, natural voice, B-roll and subtitles—without hiring actors,

items.name: Anthroposcaper
items.tagline: Tag a 2D plan, get a 3D urban environment model
items.description: Draw a 2D plan in the browser or import a DXF, then tag its faces and lines. Turn your own GLB models into templates, and Anthroposcaper lays them along every matching edge, corners and junctions included, into a textured 3D scene. Change one tag or drawing and the scene rebuilds. Export to GLB for your 3D editor or game engine. Connect your AI agent over MCP: it helps set up templates, configure tags and materials, and keep the project organized. You stay in control of the result.

items.name: JarvisCore
items.tagline: Build agents as peers in a mesh network with zero-trust
items.description: JarvisCore is a runtime where AI agents operate as a fleet of equal peers. Agents discover one another by capability, execute tasks from a shared ledger, and authenticate to every external service through a zero-trust broker, never with their own keys.

items.name: Communicate
items.tagline: AI support agents grounded in your knowledge, with handoff
items.description: Build AI support agents from your help docs, files, and past replies. Answer questions and run tasks you approve, with human handoff in a shared inbox. Add website chat, track conversations, and connect through the API or read-only MCP. Plans start at $19/month. Product Hunt offer: PRODUCTHUNT50 gives 50% off your first monthly plan payment through October 9. A separate lifetime launch offer is available on our website.

items.name: Cue by Manus
items.tagline: Personal agents with identity, handling life end to end
items.description: Whatever life brings, your personal agents on Cue handle it — each with its own email, phone number, wallet and computer to get real work done.

items.name: Codync
items.tagline: The open-source alternative to Grok Bot, Muse and Dots
items.description: Everything Grok Bot, Muse and Dots do, open source and 100% free. Run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or 40+ agents as named bots on your own computer, then reply and approve from your iPhone, Mac, Linux or terminal. MIT, end-to-end encrypted.

items.name: Wu
items.tagline: Fast, native code editor in Rust that feels like VS Code
items.description: Wu is a code editor for people who want the speed of a native app and the familiarity of VS Code.

items.name: Finbar
items.tagline: Agentic investment research
items.description: Finbar is launching public availability of its data and research platform to all investors (and their agents) - already used by several of the world's largest hedge funds. Services include: worldwide fundamental data via API/MCP; prebuilt company models and primers; and a complete AI suite for research and modelling (on web and in Excel).

items.name: Never Boring AI
items.tagline: The AI agent that writes your LinkedIn posts in your voice
items.description: Never Boring AI is an AI agent for LinkedIn. It interviews you about your work, keeps your stories in memory and turns them into posts written in your voice. It plans your content weeks ahead, learns from every edit you make, then schedules and publishes on LinkedIn for you. Built for freelancers, consultants and founders who know what they do but never know what to post this week. Works in English and French.

items.name: esigna
items.tagline: A design studio for your email signature
items.description: Your email signature should feel as considered as your website. Paste the one you use today, see your details across 26 original templates, then make it yours in a visual editor. Move blocks, refine type and spacing, add your photo, logo and booking link. Preview light, dark and mobile, then copy into Gmail, Outlook or Apple Mail. Free to design and copy. No account needed to start.
